clips.title: The story
paras: Bladefist Bay is the rugged stretch of coast lining eastern Durotar just outside the gates of Orgrimmar. Named in honor of Kargath Bladefist, the bay opens onto the Great Sea, shadowed by craggy bluffs and the nearby southern shores of Azshara.

Stretching along the northeastern edge of Durotar, Bladefist Bay opens directly into the vast waters of the Great Sea. Flanked by rocky cliffs and treacherous surf, it lies just east of the Horde capital of Orgrimmar. Directly north, the ancient red cliffs and ruins of Azshara loom across the water, making the bay a vital maritime boundary for Durotar.
